Who We Are

West Yost is a water resource management and engineering firm focused exclusively on water. Since our founding in 1990, we have partnered with public agencies including cities, counties, utilities, and water districts to plan, design, and deliver water, wastewater, and stormwater solutions that support safe, reliable, and resilient communities.

Our team of more than 265 professionals brings together expertise in groundwater, water supply, treatment, infrastructure, recycled water, stormwater, construction management, and operations technology. We support projects from early planning and permitting through design and construction and complement our engineering services with program management and public outreach to help clients move work forward and engage their communities.

We are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work®, and to be recognized among Fortune’s® Best Workplaces in Consulting and Professional Services from 2023 to 2025, as well as a top-ranked firm in the AEC Advisors Diversity Index. At West Yost, we are committed to being the water firm of choice for our clients and our team, advancing water resources for future generations through strong partnerships, practical solutions, and a shared commitment to quality.

Compensation Range: $73,202- $105,750. Based on our Irvine, CA office location.
(West Yost uses geographic salary differentials that would apply for candidates in other regions).

Status: Full-time, Exempt

Location(s): Irvine, CA (
https://www.westyost.com/locations/
).

This is a Hybrid role with 3 days in the office required.

Scientist / Geologist I

The Scientist / Geologist will work with a team of experienced hydrogeologists, engineers and environmental scientists on a variety of groundwater-related projects and investigations. The candidate will be expected to support technical work on more than one project simultaneously, work collaboratively with peers, and manage tasks with creative problem-solving skills and flexibility.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

Performs field monitoring tasks that may include: recording water well information and groundwater-level measurements, or collecting groundwater and surface water samples for laboratory analyses.
Provides support to project team members, including: developing maps, charts, and tables that convey decision-grade information; conducting research; analyzing data; preparing/writing routine reports.
Collects, performs quality assurance/quality control checks, and uploads groundwater and surface water quality and water level data into database.
Supports implementation of stakeholder processes, including: attending Board and technical committee meetings, taking meeting minutes, and preparing memos and presentations.
Communicates effectively, both written and verbal, with project managers, clients, landowners, regulators, and others as required to perform job duties.
Pursues continuous technical improvement for self and company.

Required Qualifications

Entry level to 3 years of experience in water resources
Experience with Microsoft Office Suite
Experience in the use of ArcPro or QGIS
Experience in the use of programming languages to manipulate large data sets is preferred
Excellent organizational, writing, and communication skills

Education Qualifications

Master’s degree in environmental science, geology, hydrology, hydrogeology, engineering, or a related field preferred.

Travel Requirements

This position may require travel to other offices and/or client offices.

A Little About The West Yost Life

You will experience many opportunities to grow and develop professionally with your colleagues through collaborative in-person work experience, knowledge sharing, and mentorship opportunities. We also offer hybrid and flexible work schedules to our employees to help promote and encourage a healthy work/life balance. All of our team members have access to local and company-wide events, our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Workgroup, Culture Workgroup, Wellness Workgroup, book clubs, charitable giving and community service, firm-wide resources, peer groups (young professionals & middlers group), and mentorship and leadership programs. We support and foster your career success and encourage you to be in control of your future with us.

At West Yost, we make space for connection across the firm. Each month, we hold an all-hands meeting that bring together team members from every location, including those working remotely, to stay aligned and engaged. Individual sectors and teams also hold their own monthly meeting. At the local level, our offices host gatherings, from camping trips and river rafting to community events and celebrations.

Once a year, we come together in person for our Annual All Staff event, a firmwide experience focused on learning, networking, and building relationships across teams. That evening, we continue our longest-standing tradition, the Duck Dinner, where West Yosters are encouraged to bring a guest and enjoy a night of great food, connection, and entertainment.

We work hard, and we place equal value on having fun.

Our commitment to quality begins with our hiring practices. We employ the most talented team members in our industry from all backgrounds. We are highly selective of the individuals we choose to represent the firm, seeking only those individuals whose technical abilities and commitment to client service matches our vision for excellence. We are dedicated to our number one asset, our employees. Because we are employee-owned, we are responsible for and rewarded by our own success. Come to West Yost where, with our support, you’ll do the best work of your life.

Standard Benefits

We provide a comprehensive array of valuable benefits to protect your health, your family, and your way of life. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, flexible spending accounts, health saving accounts (with West Yost contribution), paid vacation, paid sick leave and holidays, two employee assistance programs, travel assistance program, 401(k) profit sharing with employer match, leaves of absence with additional supplemental paid time off, parental leave, life and AD&D insurance, short-term and long-term disability insurance, and even pet insurance.

Other Unique Benefits

You’ll be provided with support in on-going education through our 529 college savings plan/student loan repayment program, tuition reimbursement, paid professional memberships, paid training, and Leadership Academy programs. You’ll be recognized for your contributions at West Yost through milestone anniversary benefits, peer to peer recognition programs, the potential for employee stock ownership, annual monetary and paid time off bonuses, performance-based bonus eligibility, merit increase eligibility, and employee referral bonuses. We also offer a wellness reimbursement.

Company Description

Elkhorn Environmental Solutions, Inc. (Elkhorn) is a California-based environmental consulting firm providing strategic, technically sound solutions for environmental due diligence, site investigation, remediation, redevelopment, and regulatory closure. Our multidisciplinary team brings expertise in environmental engineering, geology, toxicology, risk assessment, and applied environmental science to help clients navigate complex environmental challenges and move projects forward.
We partner with property owners, developers, attorneys, lenders, businesses, regulatory agencies, and multidisciplinary project teams to develop practical strategies tailored to project goals, regulatory requirements, and site-specific conditions. Our work includes environmental due diligence and liability evaluation; soil, soil vapor, and groundwater investigation; vapor intrusion assessment; remediation design and optimization; redevelopment support; environmental risk assessment; and regulatory closure.

At Elkhorn, our focus extends beyond identifying environmental challenges, we develop clear, defensible pathways for addressing them. We deliver practical, technically sound strategies that help clients manage risk, navigate regulatory requirements, and move sites toward successful redevelopment and closure.

Role Description

This is a full-time opportunity based Northern California, with positions available in the San Francisco Bay Area, Sacramento Region, and Sierra Foothills for Environmental Scientists, Engineers, Geologists, and Business Support Professionals at all experience levels
. Technical professionals will support projects involving site assessments, soil, soil vapor, and groundwater investigations, remediation planning and implementation, and environmental due diligence. Day-to-day responsibilities may include conducting field work, collecting and managing environmental data, preparing technical reports and figures, supporting conceptual site model development and risk evaluations, and coordinating with clients, regulators, and project partners.
Business support professionals will support the administrative, accounting, financial, and operational functions of the firm. Responsibilities may include project administration, proposal and contract support, accounts payable and receivable, invoicing and billing support, expense tracking, financial recordkeeping, project accounting, data management, scheduling, and other administrative and operational activities that help keep our projects and business running efficiently.

You will coordinate, develop, and manage a portfolio of investments, including the implementation and maintenance of activities throughout the lifecycle of grants and contracts. You will partner closely with Program Officers and Grants and Contract Services while supporting budget planning, financial analysis, financial reporting, portfolio management, and operational processes.
You will also serve as a primary investment-process contact for grantee and vendor initiation, reporting, and closure, while coordinating across multiple internal teams throughout the investment lifecycle.
This temporary Senior Program Coordinator role will support a significant portfolio of investments for the Nutrition Data and R&D teams. The assignment also includes consolidated portfolio-level reporting for leadership and ownership of CRM and annual-planning processes for the Nutrition portfolio.
Because this is a six-month interim assignment, you will need to onboard quickly, prioritize independently, and leave the portfolio well documented for the team at the end of the assignment.

What You’ll Do

Act as a subject matter authority on investment tools, systems, and templates, and provide training and coaching to program-team members and external partners when needed.
Partner with investment makers by supporting the development, management, and maintenance of a portfolio of investments.
Perform initial investment due diligence, including collecting portfolio data, identifying trends, and managing timelines.
Conduct portfolio analysis, identify risks, provide perspective on portfolio performance, and deliver detailed readouts to leadership.
Build and maintain consolidated portfolio dashboards and readouts that translate individual investment data into a clear view of overall Nutrition portfolio health for program and Foundation leadership.
Lead CRM administration for the Nutrition portfolio, including data quality, training, troubleshooting, and process support.
Coordinate the team’s annual-planning activities, including forecasting, budget cycles, and recurring portfolio reviews.
Provide in-depth project-management support to investment teams, including tracking timelines, deliverables, communications, and change-management activities.
Support the development of nontechnical project frameworks and contribute to special projects.
Build and maintain relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, including grantees, partners, Finance, Legal, and Grants and Contract Services.
Lead implementation and change efforts for the team, including developing new processes, sharing standard practices, analyzing workloads, and providing business updates.
Maintain file organization, team sites, data, records, and systems for tracking, monitoring, and prioritizing tasks and projects.
Support an inclusive culture by modeling collaborative behaviors and raising issues in a timely manner with the appropriate partners.

:
A bachelor’s degree or equivalent demonstrated experience, preferably in business administration or program management.

Practical understanding of the investment lifecycle and related rules, mechanisms, regulations, policies, processes, and practices.
Experience building portfolio-level reports or dashboards.

Comfort using AI tools, such as Copilot or Claude, to support drafting, synthesis, and reporting, along with openness to creating and adopting new AI-enabled workflows.
Experience in financial planning and budgeting.
A learning mindset and comfort navigating uncertainty, with the ability to ramp up quickly on new systems and move work forward without every input being finalized.
An optimistic and adaptable approach to shifting priorities, new tools, and competing demands.
Ability to onboard quickly and work independently within a defined, time-bound assignment. Previous interim, contract, or fast-ramp experience is a plus.
Grantmaking knowledge and previous Senior Program Coordinator experience at the Gates Foundation are strongly preferred.
Ability to communicate clearly with team members, Deputy Directors, managers, and internal and external partners.
Ability to learn new areas quickly and determine what is needed next without requiring expertise in the programmatic content.
Ability to build trust, influence individuals and teams without formal authority, and support collaboration and conflict resolution across stakeholders.
Ability to recognize complexity and assess risks and alternatives while working with competing requirements and incomplete information.

Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects.
